name: B10-0341/2025 (ECR) – Case of Ryan Cornelius in Dubai
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Ryan Cornelius in Dubai
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Ryan Cornelius, a British man held in Dubai since 2008. He finished his original 10-year sentence, but in 2018 the United Arab Emirates added 20 more years under a new law. The Parliament says this breaks international law and that his health is failing. It asks European Union diplomats to press the UAE for his release and to check on his conditions. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only asks for his release and monitoring.
- **Who it affects:** Ryan Cornelius, his family, and European Union diplomats working with the UAE.
- **What happens next:** European Union officials are urged to raise his case with the UAE and help the United Kingdom and Ireland.
